_comment: Excla Machine daily interjection puzzle. `scenarios` are hand-written absurd frames — the comedy stays human-written. A {noun} token is a swappable slot the game fills at random (day-seeded) from `nouns`, so the pool of possible daily scenarios multiplies well beyond the number of frames. Article agreement (a/an) before a slot is handled in code. Add frames and nouns freely; keep nouns concrete/countable/singular so they read after 'a'/'the'/'your'.
scenarios: a {noun} stole your {noun}
your {noun} started telling jokes
your {noun} turned into a {noun}
the moon showed up an hour early
your {noun} wandered off without you
a {noun} is doing your taxes
your left shoe learned to whistle
the vending machine gave you a live {noun}
your reflection waved back a second too late
a {noun} just quoted Shakespeare at you
your {noun} filed a complaint
the {noun} sang you a lullaby
your {noun} asked to borrow the car
gravity took the afternoon off
your umbrella opened inward and it started raining glitter
the {noun} proposed marriage
a very small {noun} is running the meeting
your {noun} began reciting poetry
the {noun} ate today's letters and burped
your {noun} rode away on its own
a {noun} parked itself in your living room
the cat unionized with the neighborhood dogs
your alarm clock apologized and let you sleep
a stranger returned the exact pen you lost in 2009
the escalator started going sideways
your {noun} winked at you
a {noun} mistook you for his {noun}
your {noun} were hidden inside a loaf of bread
the printer finally worked on the first try
the {noun} asked for directions
